The evidence leans slightly negative on the guide: a peer quantified Q4 deferrals from patients waiting for its tubeless pump, Tandem's own tubeless clearance is not visible, and international missed its guide last quarter. Against that, short interest built to 21.7% of shares outstanding and today's Insulet-driven sell-off already took 6.6% off the stock. So the lean is small and p_up sits near 50. The findings sum to -0.7 and the scaled number is -0.72, so the two measurements agree in sign and size.

FY2026 reaffirmed at $1.065-1.085B (US $730-745M, intl $335-340M), GM 56-57%, adj EBITDA 5-6% (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001438133/000143813326000124/ex991-q2earningsrelease2026.htm). Street revenue consensus $265.8-271.2M (Benzinga $265.8M, Earnings Whispers $268.05M, Chartmill/FXEmpire $271.24M), so the street sits at or above the company guide. EPS consensus -$0.24 to -$0.26 (https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/TNDM/estimates, https://www.earningswhispers.com/epsdetails/TNDM). FY guide arithmetic: H1 sales were $501.8M (Q1 $247.2M + Q2 $254.6M), so Q3 at $265M implies Q4 of $298-318M, with US Q4 at $210-225M against $210.5M in Q4 2025 (flat to +7%) and intl Q4 at $88-93M against $79.9M. The stock trades on whether that Q4/FY guide holds.

findings.finding: Beta Bionics, a direct US pump competitor, reported on 2026-10-27. It quantified up to $8.5M of Q4 2026 revenue it may lose as prospective pump users wait for its tubeless Mint (cleared 2026-09-14, full launch Q1 2027). Its pharmacy-benefit channel sales rose 118% y/y while DME rose only 4%. For Tandem the deferral is the risk: its own Mobi tubeless is promised for a 'scaled launch in H2 2026'. If buyers wait for it, the same deferral hits Tandem's implied Q4 US sales of $210-225M (flat to +7% y/y), which the FY guide needs. The pharmacy surge supports Tandem's pharmacy-led US ramp, so I net the two at a small negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: TNDM has moved on the guide and the pharmacy narrative more than on the quarter. Q2 2026 sales of $254.6M slightly missed the ~$255M guide and the stock rose 19.1%, on the FY reaffirmation and pharmacy progress. Q4 2025 issued a 'cautious' 2026 guide and the stock rose 32.7%. Q1 2026 fell 16.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: No Tandem preview found in the search connects a peer's quantified wait-for-tubeless deferral to Tandem's Q4 implied guide. If the market had priced it, street revenue would sit at or below the $265M guide, not $266-271M above it. TNDM in fact rallied from $17.43 to $19.79 in the week after the BBNX release (Yahoo chart).
findings.independence: This is a proxy, a peer's own number transmitted to Tandem. It partly shares a theme with the tubeless-clearance finding below, but the documents differ. Mint clearance date: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001674632/000119312526392088/d153052dex991.htm

findings.finding: Management said on the Q2 call (2026-08-06) that the Mobi tubeless 510(k) was submitted in Q2 and that a scaled launch would follow clearance in H2 2026, with 2027 the first full year. openFDA's 510(k) records list Tandem's latest decision as K260429 (Control-IQ+, 2026-04-24) and show no tubeless clearance. With under two months of 2026 left, the call is at risk of pushing the scaled launch into 2027, or of having to explain the timing. The other possibility is that the clearance is announced with the print, which would be a positive surprise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print has resolved tubeless timing. Pipeline milestones (Mobi Android, Libre 3 integration) were part of the narrative on the +19.1% Q2 print.
findings.why_not_priced: openFDA posts with a lag of a few weeks, so the absence is only suggestive. No press release or 8-K announced a clearance (EDGAR shows no 8-K since 2026-08-06). If a slip were priced, sell-side previews would carry a 2027 tubeless timeline; the search found none dated after August.
findings.independence: Management's timing is in the Q2 call transcript (https://www.webull.com/news/15734772929471488). The FDA-database absence is the only evidence of delay, and it is subject to the database's lag.

findings.finding: Insulet reported Q3 2026 on 2026-11-04. US Omnipod grew 14.7%, inside its 14-16% guide, and the FY US Omnipod guide was narrowed to 17.5-18.5% from 17-19% (the midpoint held). PODD then fell 6.8% intraday on 2026-11-05 and TNDM fell 6.6% alongside it, from $19.05 to $17.80. The US pump market read is in-line, not a collapse, and the sector de-rating has already taken about 7 points off TNDM into its own print, which lowers the bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not measured: the baseline does not record TNDM's sympathy moves on Insulet prints. Today's co-move of -6.6% against -6.8% shows they trade together.
findings.why_not_priced: The peer read itself is priced, since TNDM moved with PODD today. The point is that the sealed spot of $17.81 already carries a sector sell-off whose source document (US growth inside guide) does not imply Tandem-specific weakness. If the market had separated the two, TNDM would not have matched PODD's drop point for point.
findings.independence: Daily closes for both stocks, Yahoo chart v8 (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/PODD?range=10d&interval=1d and the TNDM equivalent).

findings.finding: Short interest rose from 10.59M shares (2026-08-14) to 15.09M (2026-10-15), 21.7% of shares outstanding with 6.9 days to cover. The short is crowded and was built into a print on a name whose last four reactions were +19.1%, -16.2%, +32.7% and +22.0%. An in-line print with the FY guide held is a squeeze setup.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: sales slightly below guide, short interest about 11M, stock +19.1%. Q3 2025: +22.0%. Q4 2025: +32.7% despite a 'cautious' guide.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is visible but it is a mechanism, not a view. The squeeze only fires if the release does not cut the guide. The building short is also evidence that some holders expect a cut, which is why the finding is not larger.
findings.independence: equibles, 2026-08-19 (11.2M, 16.2% of float, 6.6 days, https://equibles.com/stocks/TNDM), shows the earlier, lower level.

findings.finding: International missed its own guide last quarter. Q2 international sales were $75.3M against the ~$80M given on the Q1 call (US beat at $179.3M against ~$175M; total $254.6M against ~$255M). Management attributed about $3M to distributor buybacks and destocking, called infusion-set constraints 'worse than expected', and said they would affect 'the next couple of quarters'. Q3 international is guided to ~$85M (+15% y/y against $73.6M), and street total revenue of $266-271M sits above the $265M guide, so the bar on the quarter leans high.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: the international miss came with a total slightly below guide, and the stock still rose 19.1%. This name has not punished small total misses when the US and pharmacy lines are good. Reported-quarter misses alone have not driven its moves.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus sits above the company guide rather than below it, so the street has not built in a repeat of the international shortfall. If it had, consensus would be at or under $265M.
findings.independence: The Q1 guide for Q2 (~$255M, US ~$175M, intl ~$80M) comes from the Q1 2026 release coverage (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001438133/000143813326000048/ex991-q1earningsrelease2026.htm). The constraint commentary is from the Q2 call (https://www.webull.com/news/15734772929471488).
